HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Meta.Meta__Description: Brick coursing for elevations - stretcher bond at the co-ordinating size, 225 x 75 mm, each course half a brick along from the one below.
HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Meta.Meta__RealSize: Drawn at 1:50: a 225 x 75 mm brick is 4.5 x 1.5 mm on paper. SET PATTERN SCALE TO 50 / THE DRAWING SCALE for true courses: 0.5 at 1:100, 1 at 1:50, 2.5 at 1:20. A hatch is paper-sized and does not follow a viewport's scale by itself.
HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: Bed joints run edge to edge and sit 0.75 mm in from the top and bottom edges, never on them; the perpends of the course that wraps the seam are drawn as two halves meeting on it, square on. No line comes within 1.1 mm of a side edge.

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Identity.Identity__Note: Facing brickwork on an ELEVATION. For brickwork cut in section or on plan use Brickwork (45 degree Hatch).

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Tile.Tile__Note: Two bricks wide by four courses high - the smallest cell that repeats a stretcher bond, doubled so the PDF stamps a quarter as many tiles.

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

Courses.Glyph__Note: Four bed joints, then the perpends course by course; the last course straddles the seam, so each of its perpends is two pieces.

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Placements.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__BrickCoursing__Bounds.Bounds__Description: Scale 1 is real size at 1:50. 0.10 is 1:500 and 10 is 1:5.
